maria: hi finance — corp card showed an "FX CONVERSION FEE" of EUR 9.20 on my Amsterdam hotel charge. folio shows EUR 276.00 only. should I submit for reimbursement or will finance dispute?

jon: do you have the Ramp transaction screenshot + folio? if the merchant didn't itemize it, we typically open a dispute with the card provider first.

maria: uploaded both to Ramp (expense: AMS Hotel 2026-04-08). card last4 9876, Ramp txn id TX-44321. folio photo only lists room total and city tax.

expense-bot: Reminder: Upload original folio and card statement to the expense to trigger dispute flow. Missing docs may delay.

jon: thanks. i'll kick off a dispute with Ramp ops. if they request manager sign-off to cover temporarily we'll let you know. disputes usually take 5-15 business days.

linda: FYI travel policy note: traveling folks, ask hotels to include all charges on the final invoice to avoid disputes. i'll add a tip to the travel page.

maria: thanks! please keep me posted — prefer dispute route so my personal per-diem math stays clean.

jon: noted, opened ticket FIN-2026-998 with Ramp. i'll update this thread when there's news.
